coordinates.note: Campus-grade point: the centroid of the OSM landuse=construction area tagged "FAIR", east of the existing GSI campus (about 280 m from site:gsi-fair-darmstadt-campus). The SIS100 tunnel (1100 m circumference, up to 17 m deep) and the CBM and PANDA experimental halls are inside or beside it; no source gives their coordinates.
coordinates.quote: Currently the international accelerator facility FAIR, one of the largest research projects worldwide, is being built in Darmstadt, Germany.

name: FAIR construction site, Darmstadt
notes: The FAIR facility is "being built in Darmstadt" (FAIR home page); the point is not a hall or tunnel position.

summary.plain: The construction area next to the GSI campus in Darmstadt where the FAIR accelerator facility is being built, including the new SIS100 ring and the halls for the CBM and PANDA experiments.
summary.technical: FAIR (Facility for Antiproton and Ion Research) construction site next to GSI, Darmstadt: campus-grade point from the OSM landuse=construction area; location of the SIS100, the Super-FRS, the storage rings and the CBM and PANDA experiments.
